title: Robot World Models Are Not Invariant to How the Actions Are Written
abstract: arXiv:2609.23252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A robot policy is trained with one of two action parameterizations: absolute joint targets, or deltas relative to the current state. The choice is a live engineering decision in robot learning, and a world model conditioned on actions inherits it silently. We show the inheritance is catastrophic. A latent dynamics model trained on one parameterization and handed the identical commanded trajectory written in the other collapses: retrieval degrades by 2.6-13.4x across three robot datasets and two morphologies, goal-conditioned action selection falls from 53% to 15%, and on PushT the two beliefs about the same future are near-orthogonal (cos = 0.067, worst case -0.377), so the predictor does not degrade gracefully, it answers a different question. This is not a distribution-shift artifact in the usual sense: the two encodings are mutually reconstructible at R^2 = 0.996 given the joint input, so no information is lost, and we give the test

translated_title: 机器人世界模型对动作的书写方式不具备不变性
translated_abstract: 机器人策略通常采用两种动作参数化方式之一进行训练：绝对关节目标，或相对于当前状态的增量。这一选择是机器人学习中的一个现实工程决策，而以动作为条件的世界模型会默默继承这一选择。我们证明这种继承是灾难性的。在一个参数化上训练的潜在动力学模型，若被给予以另一种参数化书写的完全相同的指令轨迹，会发生崩溃：在三个机器人数据集和两种机器人形态上，检索性能下降2.6-13.4倍；目标条件下的动作选择成功率从53%降至15%；在PushT任务上，关于同一未来的两种信念几乎正交（cos = 0.067，最差情况为-0.377），因此预测器并非优雅地退化，而是在回答一个不同的问题。这并非通常意义上的分布偏移伪影：给定联合输入，两种编码可以相互重建（R² = 0.996），因此没有任何信息丢失。
tldr: 本文揭示了机器人世界模型对动作参数化方式（绝对关节目标与相对增量）不具备不变性——即使两种编码在信息上完全等价（可相互重建），切换参数化方式也会导致模型灾难性崩溃而非优雅退化。
en_tdlr: Robot world models are catastrophically non-invariant to action parameterization—swapping between absolute joint targets and relative deltas collapses model performance despite the two encodings being informationally equivalent and mutually reconstructible.
